# V. From package to platform {.unnumbered}

The same product definition can participate in a much larger data architecture. This part connects the R workflow to broader platform concepts without claiming that DataRaft replaces every surrounding tool.

You will separate logical meaning from physical execution, position DataRaft alongside dbt, DuckDB, DuckLake, OpenMetadata, OpenLineage, pointblank, and orchestration tools, and then turn the workflow into a repeatable development and CI process.

::: {.callout-note title="By the end of this part"}
You should be able to place DataRaft inside a modern data stack, choose which responsibility belongs to which component, and define a practical path from local development to automated checks.
:::
